method: Regional ecological mixture regression under aggregate multinomial pseudo-likelihood, not exact individual-transition likelihood. Regional fits penalized toward global fit via pseudo-count alpha per origin.
split: Municipalities hash SHA256(UF:municipality)%5: 0=test, 1=tuning, 2-4=training. Selection uses tuning weighted MAE; test held out.
limitations: Transfer rates are model-dependent, not observed voter trajectories or certified accuracy.
Regional association is not individual behavior. Co-location, collinearity and turnout changes affect identifiability.
Pseudo-likelihood is an approximation to ecological table likelihood. Alpha choices and fit family are exploratory.
Global convex optimization bound applies only to the specified objective; not all possible behavioral models.
Final table uses selected training-only model on all first-turn margins; no forced match to second-turn totals.
Test metrics evaluate section outcomes, not correctness of origin-to-destination migration.
Source repository derivatives not independently authenticated here.
Sparse origins require particular caution; numerical convergence is not identification.
